buyer: Danish Ministry of Defence Acquisition and Logistics Organisation
title: Airborne Maritime Pollution Surveillance
description: This tender concerns a contract for Airborne Maritime Pollution Surveillance. The overall purpose is to limit and mitigate pollution in the Danish waters — territorial sea and the Danish economic exclusive zone (as defined in the Danish act on Protection of the Marine Environment (in Danish: Havmiljøloven) section 5) by performing airborne maritime pollution control and to enforce the Danish act on Protection of the Marine Environment (in Danish: Havmiljøloven). Further information about the characteristics of the airborne maritime pollution control can be obtained from the following sources: — The United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea; UNCLOS; — The Bonn-Agreement; — The Helsinki Convention (HELCOM); — The DENGERNETH Plan; — The SWEDENGER Plan; — The Copenhagen Agreement. The supplier enters this agreement with DALO as the contracting party, and the inherent tasks are performed by the Danish Defence. The responsibility for pollution response and counter-pollution surveillance of the marine environement rests with the Ministry of Resilience and Preparedness. As such, this agreement may be subject to transfer to the Ministry of Resilience and Preparedness or an agency under the Ministry's purview, such as the Danish Emergency Management Agency. The maritime pollution surveillance is conducted by airborne area coverage of the Danish waters and this is supplemented by satellite based surveillance by European Maritime Safety Agency (EMSA). The Supplier of Airborne Maritime Pollution Surveillance shall overfly areas within the Danish waters — territorial sea and the Danish economic exclusive zone (as defined in the Danish act on Protection of the Marine Environment section 5) two times weekly. The flights shall take place both at day time and at night time and under all weather conditions of common occurrence in the respective areas. Flights will be scheduled by the Supplier. During the flights the Danish waters shall be monitored with the purpose of identifying prospective pollution. Monitoring shall be conducted by means of sensor equipment, which is capable of monitoring the water surface for oil spill etc. The sensor equipment must be made available by the Supplier. During the flights the Supplier shall collect evidence of any observed pollution, hereunder by photo and other documentation and by means of air-drop of oil spill sampling buoys, with the purpose of for example giving the Danish Authorities information to assess the measures to be taken in combating the pollution and providing evidence for further investigation and/or preliminary charges. Specifically the Supplier shall provide the following for airborne maritime pollution surveillance: — Flight system; — sensor equipment; — air crew and system operators necessary for operating flight system and sensor equipment. The Supplier must prior to commencement undertake extensive practical training of his air crew and system operators. The Supplier must ensure that the system operators are at all times duly qualified and trained to perform the task. The Supplier shall be available for participation in multinational operations on behalf of Denmark. The number of such operations is expected to be up to three per year. Participation in such operations is comparable to the flights as described above. The Supplier shall be available/stand by for the duration of these operations.

description: Ruoppauksen hankinta Parikkalan Siikalahdelle 2026 - 2027 Metsähallitus kilpailuttaa Ruoppauksen Parikkalan Siikalahdelle tämän tarjouspyynnön sekä liitteenä olevan aineiston mukaisesti. Tehtävänä on suorittaa Parikkalan Siikalahdella kunnostusruoppauksia. Siikalahti sijaitsee Parikkalan keskustaajamasta noin 3 km itään. Siikalahden halkaisee sen läpi kulkeva Kaukolantie, jakaen Siikalahden etelä- ja pohjoisosiin. Kunnostettavat alueet sijaitsevat pääosin aivan Kaukolantien tuntumassa. Siikalahti on Parikkalassa sijaitseva järvi, joka on liitetty Natura 2000 -verkostoon lintudirektiivin mukaisena erityisenä suojelualueena (SPA). Se on sisämaan arvokkaimpia lintuvesiä. Siikalahti on pitkä umpeenkasvanut Simpelejärven lahtialue. Hankkeen tavoitteena on parantaa vesilintujen sekä muiden kosteikkolajien elinolosuhteita kunnostamalla täysin umpeutunutta luhtaa Siikalahden Natura-alueen eteläosassa Kaukolantien varressa ja pieniä alueita pohjoisosassa, jotka jäivät keväällä 2026 toteutetuissa kunnostuksissa valmistumatta. Molemmat alueet ovat umpeenkasvaneet ja kunnostus toteutetaan lisäämällä avovesialueen määrää kaivamalla pois kelluvaa sammal-, luhta- ja vesikasvillisuutta. Samalla poistetaan pääosin hentokasvustoista pajukkoa sekä koivua, joita poistetaan juurineen. Lisäksi joiltain osin paljastetaan liejukkoa sekä tehdään kausikosteikkomaisia painanteita. Pohjasedimenttiä ei ruopata. Hankintaa ei ole jaettu osiin. Hankinnan jakaminen osiin lisäisi työvaiheiden yhteensovittamistarvetta, kasvattaisi viivästys- ja vastuunjakoriskejä sekä vaikeuttaisi kokonaisuuden hallintaa. Pk-yritysten osallistumismahdollisuudet on huomioitu mitoittamalla soveltuvuusvaatimukset hankinnan kohteeseen nähden oikeasuhtaisiksi. Näillä perusteilla hankintayksikkö katsoo, ettei hankinnan jakaminen osiin ole tarkoituksenmukaista.,

Rammeavtalen skal dekke kommunenes løpende behov for blant annet trygghetsalarmer, elektroniske medisindispensere, sensorteknologi og øvrige velferdsteknologiske produkter. Formålet med avtalen er å bidra til trygge, effektive og fremtidsrettede helse- og omsorgstjenester, samt legge til rette for økt mestring, selvstendighet og trygghet for brukerne. Anskaffelsen inkluderer opsjoner på velferdsteknologisk plattform, responssenter og responstjenester samt pasientvarslingsanlegg. Leveranser under rammeavtalen reguleres gjennom SSA-R som overordnet avtale, med tilhørende avropsavtaler basert på relevante SSA-standarder. Avtalen er en felles rammeavtale for Gjøvik kommune, Gran kommune, Nordre Land kommune og Søndre Land kommune. Følgende kommuner er opsjonskommuner med rett, men ingen plikt, til å tiltre rammeavtalen: Vestre Toten kommune, Østre Toten kommune, Nord-Aurdal kommune, Sør-Aurdal kommune, Øystre Slidre kommune, Vestre Slidre kommune, Etnedal kommune, Vang kommune og Eidskog kommune. Det gis ingen garanti for at opsjonskommunene vil tiltre rammeavtalen eller foreta anskaffelser under avtalen.

Le nouveau SAEIV devra remplacer intégralement le système actuellement en service, déployé en 2017, avec une mise en service cible fixée à 2027. Cette évolution technologique devra s'effectuer en assurant la continuité de service et en garantissant la compatibilité avec l'ensemble des interfaces existantes, et notamment les outils métiers des exploitants (supervision, planification et suivi en temps réel de l'exploitation), le matériel roulant et les équipements embarqués : collecte et transmission fluides des données d'exploitation et les systèmes et équipements d'information voyageurs embarqués (afficheur s, annonces sonores) et au sol (bornes, panneaux d'affichage dynamique). Le projet devra également intégrer les évolutions technologiques récentes, améliorer la performance globale du système, renforcer la cyber-sécurité et offrir une meilleure ergonomie aux utilisateurs finaux.

title: Germany – Contractor's all-risk insurance services – Projektversicherung ESTW Delmenhorst
description: Die DB InfraGO AG plant die Erneuerung des Stellwerks in Delmenhorst. Die Investitionssumme für dieses Projekt wird mit EUR 92,0 Mio. veranschlagt. Hiervon sind bereits ca. EUR 4,2 Mio. über einen bestehenden Vertrag abgerechnet worden. Der hier neu ausgeschriebene Versicherungsvertrag wird den bestehenden Vertrag ablösen. Es wird mit einer derzeit geplanten Bauzeit bis zum 07.12.2029 gerechnet. Der Versicherungsvertrag beginnt nach Beendigung des Ausschreibungsverfahrens mit dem Datum des Zuschlages im Anschluss an eine derzeit bestehende Vorlaufdeckung. (Typ M) In der Haftpflichtversicherung beträgt die Deckungssumme je Schadenfall EUR 25.000.000 pauschal für Personen-, Sach- und Vermögensschäden, einschließlich der Leistungen aus der Umwelthaftpflichtversicherung. In der Planungshaftpflichtversicherung steht eine separate Deckungssumme je Schadenfall von EUR 10.000.000 pauschal für Sach- und Vermögensschäden zur Verfügung. Die vorgenannten Summen sind dreifach maximiert. Die Extendend Maintenance im Teil Bauleistungs- und Montageversicherung beträgt 42 Monate. Die Nachhaftung beträgt in der Haftpflichtversicherung 10 Jahre, in der Umwelthaftpflicht- und Umweltschadenversicherung 5 Jahre. Der generelle Selbstbehalt beträgt mindestens EUR 25.000. Für Personenschäden entfällt der Selbstbehalt. In der Planungshaftpflichtversicherung ist die erweiterte Planungsdeckung eingeschlossen. Im Rahmen der erweiterten Planungsdeckung beträgt der Selbstbehalt EUR 100.000

title: Provision of Audience Research Services
description: The Board of Trustees for the National Galleries of Scotland ("NGS") wish to award a Contract for the Provision of Audience Research Services. The Service Provider is required to conduct Audience Research to provide insight and analysis about our visitors in order to support the Organisationâs 2030 Strategy, Business Plan and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), special projects and inform organisation-wide strategic planning. The Service Provider shall be a member of, accredited by, or operate in accordance with the standards, codes of conduct and professional requirements of the Market Research Society (MRS) or an equivalent recognised professional body for market research, social research, insight or analytics. This Contract shall primarily provide Fieldwork Surveys and associated Project Management, Client Data Access, Analysis and Reporting for each of our four gallery sites. Services will be agreed to on an âas requiredâ basis with no commitment to a minimum volume of work. NGS may, at its absolute discretion, require the Service Provider to provide Audience Research Services at this fifth site, currently under construction, at any time during the Contract term. If permitted by applicable procurement legislation, where additional audience research requirements arise during the Contract term that constitute an extension of the Services, NGS reserves the right to procure such additional services from the Service Provider. For full details of the Contract Requirements please refer to the associated Tender and Contract Documents. The Service Provider must have a clear understanding of the contract requirements and the organisational needs of NGS. As part of the tender exercise, the Service Provider must detail a robust and flexible methodology for conducting Audience Research Services that will meet all data capture requirements. There is no commitment to a minimum spend over the duration of the Contract. Under this Contract, no minimum spend is guaranteed. The agreement will be non-exclusive i.e. NGS reserves the right, in certain, circumstances, to procure out with the Contract Agreement, as and when required. In the event of unsatisfactory performance by the successful Service Provider and the termination of the contract by either party, NGS reserves the right to negotiate the continuance of the services with the second and third placed Service Providers.

title: Projekt 1034: Technische Umsetzung einer SBOM für KI (SBOM4AI)
description: Im Bereich der klassischen Software finden Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs) – also Stücklisten, die Informationen über Softwarekomponenten und deren Abhängigkeiten beinhalten – schon lange Anwendung und werden vom Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) sogar gefordert. Diese Forderung gilt auch für KI-Systeme, jedoch ist die Idee einer SBOM spezifisch für KI-Systeme relativ neu. Erste Ansätze bergen daher die Gefahr, dass sie nicht alle notwendigen Aspekte im Hinblick auf die Transparenz der KI-Lieferkette abdecken. In diesem Projekt soll das im G7-Rahmen veröffentlichte Konzept "SBOM for AI - Minimum Elements" in die Praxis überführt und dafür eine technische Umsetzung der definierten Kriterien erarbeitet werden. Die SBOM für KI soll automatisiert erstellt und in einem geeigneten Format ausgegeben werden. Die erarbeitete Umsetzung soll anschließend allen Interessenträgern zur Verfügung gestellt werden, um so einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Cybersicherheit von KI-Systemen leisten zu können.

title: Analysis of the Beluga Fattening Cycle using photogrammetry
description: Fisheries and Oceans Canada (DFO) requires scientific expertise to assess the importance of spring in the annual fattening cycle of the endangered St. Lawrence Estuary beluga population. The contractor will conduct advanced photogrammetric and morphometric analyses using image analysis software to refine sex identification, identify pregnant females, and assess changes in physical condition across age and sex classes. The work also includes the preparation and publication of two scientific articles that meet the standards of internationally recognized peer-reviewed scientific journals.

Järjestelmään tulee sisältyä ohjelmantoimittajan tukipalvelut ja mahdollisten uusien ominaisuuksien perehdytykset käyttäjille. title: Reintegration Services and Indigenous Community Support
description: An advanced contract award notice (ACAN) is a public notice indicating to the supplier community that a department or agency intends to award a contract for goods, services or construction to a pre-identified supplier, thereby allowing other suppliers to signal their interest in bidding, by submitting a statement of capabilities. If no supplier submits a statement of capabilities that meets the requirements set out in the ACAN, on or before the closing date and time stated in the ACAN, the contracting officer may then proceed with the award to the pre-identified supplier. 1. Definition of the requirement: Policy on Reciprocal Procurement: the Policy on Reciprocal Procurement does not apply to this procurement. The Correctional Service of Canada has a requirement to provide in person support and assistance to Indigenous offenders to help them enter the workforce, including real-life, day to day mentorship and job preparedness development. The work will involve the following: 1.1 Objectives: The Contractor must provide reintegrative supports to Indigenous offenders, including First Nations, Métis and Inuit, such as Elder support, cultural teachings, counselling and hard and soft employability skills. title: Air Bath for Standard Resistors
description: An air bath for standard resistors is a temperature-controlled enclosure that maintains precision resistance standards at a stable and uniform temperature. Since the resistance value of standard resistors is temperature dependent, tight temperature control is essential for accurate resistance measurements used in thermometry applications such as standard platinum resistance thermometer calibrations. The laboratory is acquiring an air bath to replace the current oil bath system. Compared to oil baths, air baths provide cleaner operation, lower maintenance, no risk of oil contamination or leakage, and easier handling of resistors and wiring, while maintaining excellent temperature stability for precision measurements.

title: Geographic Information System Data Architect
description: This bid solicitation is being issued to satisfy the requirement of one (1) G.5 Geographic Information System Data Architect, Level 3 for Housing, Infrastructure and Communities Canada for Task-Based Informatics Professional Services (TBIPS) under the TBIPS Supply Arrangement (SA) method of supply. The primary objective is to establish a centralized geospatial data environment within the organization’s Azure-based Unified Data Platform (UDP). This environment will enable the efficient ingestion, validation, storage, integration, sharing, and spatial analysis of geospatial data across the organization, while supporting real-time relationships between spatial data and enterprise business datasets, automation, and more consistent, data-driven decision-making. In addition, the organization is looking for a cost-benefit analysis and recommendation of options to procure a modern geospatial platform, including how these options compare and integrate with HICC’s existing spatial capabilities and data ecosystems. The analysis will assess the potential value, costs, and implementation considerations associated with these platforms, and identify opportunities for location-based analysis, research, reporting, evaluation, automation, and application geoprocessing capabilities across the department.
